sections.content: You know the simple future from A2 Unit 19. Use it for predictions, expectations and future results: the speaker presents an event as expected rather than already arranged. Here you use it with *creo que* to make predictions.

items.spanish: Si seguimos así, terminaremos antes del plazo.
items.english: If we keep going like this, we'll finish before the deadline.

items.spanish: Creo que el proyecto tendrá éxito porque cuenta con suficiente apoyo.
items.english: I think the project will succeed because it has enough support.
Will you arrive on time if you leave now?

items.spanish: No te preocupes: encontraremos una solución.
items.english: Don't worry: we'll find a solution.

sections.content: Future endings are added to the whole infinitive: *terminar* becomes *terminaremos*, *encontrar* becomes *encontraremos*. A few verbs change the stem, for example *tener* becomes *tendrá* and *haber* becomes *habrá*.
